basis: Childhood autonomic nonepileptic spells; transient apnea and syncope do not establish pulmonary damage.
Malignant epithelial tumor arising in salivary glands, which belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Inherited corneal disease with opacification, vascularization and impaired vision; no evidence of an immune mechanism.
Lysosomal lipid storage disorder; hepatic failure and intestinal malabsorption 80-99%; anemia 30-79% with splenic storage. Developmental delay need not indicate direct CNS damage.
Benign tumor arising in the endocardium.
Defining cutaneous, ocular and progressive CNS abnormalities; anemia 30-79%. Dental and joint abnormalities also 30-79%, omitted by cap.
Pontocerebellar malformation with severe developmental impairment; coloboma in 2/6 supports ocular involvement, although the cohort is small.
Congenital muscular dystrophy with defining brain and eye anomalies; muscle dystrophy and brain malformations 6/6, retinal dysplasia and glaucoma each 2/6.
Inherited macular degeneration confined to the ocular axis.
Glycosylation disorder defined by neurologic dysfunction and hypogammaglobulinemia. Broader hepatic, cardiac, auditory and optic findings are occasional.
Umbrella disorder of the lower respiratory tract; no additional organ or mechanism applies across the group.
Tumor of the pineal endocrine gland within the CNS; hydrocephalus and gaze abnormalities reflect intracranial effects rather than primary eye disease.
Occlusion of a retinal arterial branch directly affects both a blood vessel and the retina.
Autoimmune neuromuscular junction dysfunction despite negative standard antibody testing; weakness does not establish primary muscle or eye damage.
Inherited melanin synthesis disorder causing skin/hair hypopigmentation and ocular abnormalities with impaired vision.
Inherited parathyroid hormone deficiency or dysfunction; additional organ damage is not established across this heterogeneous umbrella.
Congenital systemic venous drainage malformation; paradoxical embolization is a risk rather than established additional organ damage.
Carcinoma arising in the thyroid endocrine gland; other reported cancers are separate diseases and each occurs in only 1/4.
Failure of aspirin to suppress platelet activity defines a platelet functional phenotype; cardiovascular events are downstream risks or separate diseases.
Intermittent protrusion of the eye classified as an orbital adnexal disorder; no specific vascular cause is established.
Progressive distal skeletal muscle myopathy; no evidence that cardiac or neurologic damage commonly accompanies this subtype.
Molecular subtype of glioblastoma, a primary CNS tumor.
Primary biliary cholangitis is autoimmune destruction of intrahepatic bile ducts; associated autoimmune diseases are separately diagnosed.
Defining bladder dysfunction and intestinal hypoperistalsis; cerebral white matter atrophy reported in 1/1, with limited frequency certainty. Infections are secondary complications.
RFX7-associated neurodevelopmental disorder with intellectual, speech and motor impairment; other organ abnormalities are uncommon.
